title: Trisha
engine: Front end: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, hand-written CSS
coverAlt: Trisha cover board: a barbershop website with a desktop and a mobile screen of the home page.
brief: The goal was to replace a paper appointment book with a phone-first booking flow for a one-chair shop, with the price and duration visible before anything is chosen.
summary: Website for a traditional barbershop, with four-step online booking and a small shop.
